overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair did not reasonably anticipate discussing the Town Planner position at the February 10 meeting, so it did not need to be on the notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed the Town Planner position at its February 10 meeting although the posted notice did not list that topic.
allegations.key_passage: We find that discussion of the Town Planner position during the February 10 meeting was not anticipated by the Chair.
